user.title: Weekly Planner
user.description: Add the Weekly Planner. Programs are then created from the Weekly Planner card.

init.title: Weekly Planner
init.description: What do you want to do?

data.reapply_default: Send the current setting again after a restart or a change (default for new programs)
data.notify_delay_min: Alert when a device has been unavailable for
data.debounce_min: Wait before applying a change of condition

data_description.notify_delay_min: If a device driven by a schedule stays unavailable longer than this, Home Assistant shows a notification. The setting is sent again by itself when the device comes back.
data_description.debounce_min: A program can have conditions that you add yourself, for example “someone is home” or “temperature > 24 °C”. When one of them changes, Weekly Planner waits this long before acting, to ignore brief flickers. 0 = immediately.
data_description.mode_selector: A Home Assistant selector (input_select or select) whose current choice is the active Mode of the house, for example Home, Away or Vacation. Weekly Planner only reads it and never changes it. Leave empty to have a single Mode.

resync.title: Resynchronise the devices
resync.description:
Use this after an outage. Every program is looked at. Nothing has been sent yet. Pressing Submit sends the commands below for real to your devices (shutters, heating, lights…), one device at a time, and they will act immediately. Programs that are paused or off, and devices changed by a person since their last one-shot, are left alone.

{plan}

default_mode.title: Default Mode
default_mode.description: Choose the Mode used when the selector has no usable choice.

data_description.default_mode: The Mode used when the selector has no usable choice. Pick it among the options of the selector. Weekly Planner only reads the selector and never changes it.

abort.resync_nothing: Nothing to send: every device is left alone.

error.invalid_mode_selector_domain: Choose an input_select or a select.
error.circular_mode_selector: This entity belongs to Weekly Planner. Choose another one.
error.invalid_default_mode: Enter a Mode name of 1 to 40 characters.
error.unknown_default_mode: This Mode is not an option of the selector. Choose one from the list.

apply_now.name: Apply now
apply_now.description: Sends right now what the devices of the program should be doing, even if they are already in that state; also the last one-shot started less than 24 hours ago, unless a person changed the device since. Returns the devices sent and left alone.

skip_next.name: Skip next change
skip_next.description: Do not apply the next change of a program.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Put a program on pause for a number of days and/or hours, then resume it automatically.

days.name: Days
days.description: How long the pause lasts, in days (added to the hours).

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: How long the pause lasts, in hours (added to the days). Give at least the days or the hours.

missing_entities.title: Weekly Planner: entities removed
missing_entities.description: Some programs use entities that no longer exist: {details}. Edit these programs in the Weekly Planner card.

yaml_invalid.title: Weekly Planner: YAML file ignored
yaml_invalid.description: The file weekly_planner.yml in /config/www was not imported and nothing was changed: {error}. Fix the file; it is read again within 30 seconds.

modes_now_global.title: Weekly Planner: modes are now global
modes_now_global.description: The mode is now the same for all programs and chosen by one selector (an input_select or select entity) set in the Weekly Planner settings. The per-program mode choice and its select entity were removed. Programs concerned: {programs}. Each program keeps its first mode as the default mode and its other modes are matched to the selector options by name.

mode_option_missing.title: Weekly Planner: a mode matches no option
mode_option_missing.description: These modes have schedules but are no longer an option of the mode selector: {modes}. They are kept, inactive, and nothing was erased. Options no program uses yet: {options}. Open the schedules screen to match each mode to an option, or to delete it.

pause_range.message: A pause lasts 1 hour to {max_days} days

source_missing.message: Value source is missing or unavailable

source_not_number.message: Value source is not a number

source_not_finite_number.message: Value source is not a finite number

source_not_boolean.message: Value source is not a boolean

source_needs_state.message: Value sources require Home Assistant state access
